$comment: Machine-readable registry of the standard resource property vocabulary (D-46, closes G-6). The canonical prose form is SPEC.md § Resource Property Vocabulary; an SDK test (sdk/src/__tests__/resource-properties.test.ts) keeps the two consistent, so drift fails CI. Semantics notes are descriptive only: they record the documented meaning and existing provider latitude, and never settle a semantic the spec leaves undefined. Known-type vocabularies are OPEN — providers MAY expose extension properties; tooling warns (never errors) on properties outside this registry. Unknown resource types have no vocabulary here and stay fully open (L-4). Credential classification is independent of this registry: `password`, `secret_key`, `access_key`, and every `*_key` / `*_key_file` name are credential-bearing whether or not a type's vocabulary lists them (D-56 rule 5).

postgres.url: Fully-formed connection string (e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname); TLS mode is provider latitude
postgres.host: Hostname or address the database is reachable at
postgres.name: Name of the provisioned database

mysql.url: Fully-formed connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
mysql.host: Hostname or address the database is reachable at
mysql.name: Name of the provisioned database

sqlite.url: Fully-formed connection string for the database file
sqlite.path: Filesystem path of the database file

mongodb.url: Fully-formed connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
mongodb.host: Hostname or address the database is reachable at
mongodb.name: Name of the provisioned database

redis.url: Fully-formed connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
redis.host: Hostname or address the server is reachable at

memcache.host: Hostname or address the server is reachable at

rabbitmq.url: Fully-formed connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
rabbitmq.host: Hostname or address the broker is reachable at

elasticsearch.url: Fully-formed connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
elasticsearch.host: Hostname or address the cluster is reachable at

minio.url: Fully-formed endpoint connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
minio.host: Hostname or address the object store is reachable at
minio.port: Port the object store listens on

clickhouse.url: Fully-formed connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
clickhouse.host: Hostname or address the database is reachable at
clickhouse.name: Name of the provisioned database

kafka.url: Fully-formed connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
kafka.host: Hostname or address the broker is reachable at

s3.url: Fully-formed endpoint connection string; TLS mode is provider latitude
s3.region: Region identifier of the provisioned bucket

https-origin.url: The public origin browsers reach the app at, scheme https (e.g. https://vault.example.com) — the same value as $app.url

certificate.cert_file: App-filesystem path of the PEM certificate (with any chain) the component's own listener serves
certificate.key_file: App-filesystem path of the PEM private key for cert_file — credential-bearing: a provider registers its value with its redactor before generating anything (D-56 rule 5), whatever its vocabulary membership
